parts.name: platforms
parts.description: The BotPlatformPlugin interface and the rules every plugin follows (session fetch, deadlines, authenticate, normalize, receiver and fatal faults, the one wire error); how a platform is added as a plugin package (connect) without touching the core; the registry; the mock transport, mock calls with `auth`, simulate's path, makeBotMockHelper and the configurable test platform. Each platform's own API calls are its plugin package's skill (bot-telegram, bot-whatsapp, bot-discord, bot-slack in connect).
